sql:
create or replace function public.emit_event(
  p_type text,
  p_entity text,
  p_entity_id uuid,
  p_payload jsonb,
  p_actor_id uuid default null
)
returns uuid
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  -- A type outside the catalog fails the check constraint, so the caller's write rolls back with it.
  insert into public.events (type, entity, entity_id, payload, actor_id)
  values (p_type, p_entity, null, coalesce(p_payload, '{}'::jsonb), p_actor_id)
  returning id
$$;

expect: × .*emit_event inserts a row of a catalog type[\s\S]*\+   "entity_id": null

create or replace function public.job_event_entity_id(j public.jobs)
returns uuid

stable

as $$
  -- G64: a PostgREST computed field, so one `or` filter finds an entity's jobs through their event.
  select e.id from public.events e where e.id = j.event_id
$$;
